model_detail: Public project attribution follows the user-designated primary authorship GPT-5.6-Sol + Claude Code. This stage was actually generated and orchestrated in Claude Code; no local OpenAI API call is claimed. Auxiliary tools actually used: Python 3.11.14, Pillow 12.0.0, ReportLab 5.0.0, PyMuPDF 1.28.2, Shapely 2.1.2, pyproj 3.7.2, Node.js 22.22.2, and repository validation/rendering scripts.
method_zh: 用于双语论证、治理记录、证据闭合，以及程序制图、离线长卷和A3/A0 PDF的确定性重建；不执行finalize或持久化四门自检。
method_en: Used for bilingual argument, governance records, evidence closure, and deterministic reconstruction of programmatic figures, offline long-scroll pages, and A3/A0 PDFs; it does not finalize or persist four-gate review claims.

auxiliary_tools.purpose: proposal, generator, visual-system, and QA orchestration
high-resolution bilingual programmatic PNG figures using local Windows CJK fonts
composed bilingual A3/A0 PDFs with subset-embedded local fonts
PDF page, size, and text QA
concept geometry, topology, and spatial figure geometry
EPSG:4326 to EPSG:4548 area and drawing transforms

local CJK text rendering; font files are not redistributed
